hookSwap.$comment: The placeValue4Digit hook asserted something a Sri Lankan child knows is false. Books here cost 3-digit prices, so 'book prices are four-digit numbers' is wrong on the facts — and a hook that opens on something the child can see is untrue costs more than a weak hook does. A school bag genuinely runs to four digits. Round 2's logic fix is kept: what makes the number readable is knowing where its digits sit, not how many there are. Both sentences stay under 14 words.

softenToSoftCheck.$comment: Half the authored ASKs become SOFT_CHECKs. An ASK stops the lesson, opens the mic for a judged answer and runs an 8s/12s/10s silence ladder into FEEDBACK or RETEACH; a SOFT_CHECK opens the mic for 3s, warmly acknowledges any sound, and flows on unjudged. The script asked one judged question every 35s, so a 12-minute sitting carried ~21 of them. Every beat kept below is a real checkpoint; every beat here is a repeat of the checkpoint before it, or a question that answers itself, or one that cannot be judged at all. Beat TYPE and pauseType both change; the words are untouched.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:readWrite4Digit:3: 2nd of three warm-up 'read this number' beats. :2 is the checkpoint; the guide wants all three read aloud, which a 3s mic still invites.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:readWrite4Digit:22: Open-ended: the child builds ANY number from 1/3/6/4. expectedAnswer was 1364, so a child answering 6431 — equally correct — was marked wrong and reteached. Cannot be judged; expectedAnswer dropped.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:readWrite4Digit:27: Same open-ended task, second pass. expectedAnswer dropped.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:readWrite4Digit:29: Same open-ended task, third pass ('make another one'). expectedAnswer dropped.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:placeValue4Digit:46: 2nd of four consecutive 'how many beads at this place?' on the same abacus. :44 is the checkpoint.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:placeValue4Digit:68: 2nd of four consecutive 'what value does this place give?' on the same number. :66 is the checkpoint.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:placeValue4Digit:82: The question states the answer inside itself ('එකස්ථානයේ තියෙන්නේ පබළු දෙකයි') and then asks for the value of those two at the ones place. Nothing is being diagnosed.
softenToSoftCheck.authored:placeValue4Digit:100: Immediate follow-on of :98, which already identified the digit; this asks the value of the 5 the child just named.
